## Where it goes

<!-- Pick one; CONTRIBUTING.md has the branch rules. -->

- [ ] `main`: a feature, or a fix for something not yet released
- [ ] `release/X.Y`: a fix for a version in beta or on the App Store (no new features)

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests in StarHashKit for any logic that can run without the UI
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md` if someone using StarHash would notice (under `[Unreleased]` on main, under the version on a release branch)
- [ ] Unfinished work is behind a feature flag with rollout `.dev`
- [ ] Screenshots in light and dark mode for a change to how a screen looks
